beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until FlashAttention unlocks 3x throughput?
beats.visual_focus: Grid visualization of memory latency between HBM and SRAM.

beats.text: The bottleneck is IO complexity; every attention step forces a massive write-read trip between the GPU cores and HBM.
beats.visual_focus: Red glowing arcs showing data bouncing between memory and compute units.

beats.text: FlashAttention pivots by tiling the attention matrix into smaller blocks, keeping data strictly inside the lightning-fast on-chip SRAM.
beats.visual_focus: Matrix breaking into 2D tiles moving into SRAM.

beats.text: By fusing softmax computation within these tiles, we eliminate intermediate write-steps to HBM, maximizing the 20 TB/s on-chip bandwidth.
